mapper.select: select ms.module_code as moduleCode, ms.module_name as moduleName, ms.count_type as countType, ms.min_count as minCount, ms.max_count as maxCount, ms.need_formula as needFormula, ms.need_image as needImage, ms.need_code as needCode, ms.editable as editable, mc.id as contentId, mc.status as status, mc.progress as progress, mc.word_count as wordCount, mc.item_count as itemCount, mc.version as version, mc.update_time as updateTime, sc.score as score from te_module_set ms left join te_module_content mc on mc.group_id = #{groupId} and mc.module_code = ms.module_code left join te_module_score_set sc on sc.class_id = #{classId} and sc.module_code = ms.module_code where ms.class_id = #{classId} order by ms.module_code

select id, group_id, module_code, content, status, progress, version, word_count, item_count, submit_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from te_module_content where group_id = #{groupId} and module_code = #{moduleCode}
mapper.insert: insert into te_module_content (group_id, module_code, content, status, progress, version, word_count, item_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{groupId}, #{moduleCode}, #{content}, #{status}, #{progress}, 0, #{wordCount}, #{itemCount}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update te_module_content set content = #{content}, status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, word_count = #{wordCount}, item_count = #{itemCount}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), submit_time = sysdate() submit_time , version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
